items.title: Islamic Star Pattern Courtyard Gate Vector with Calligraphy Header
items.description: A magnificent Islamic-style double gate design showcasing a beautiful semi-oval cluster of interlocking star polygons (Girih). The design is crowned with a highly detailed Bismillah Islamic calligraphy header panel, perfect for religious or cultural architectural projects.

items.title: Clover Cross Floral DXF Lattice for Classic Interior Screens
items.description: Four-lobed clover motifs interlock into a tight repeating cross lattice, giving a refined, tile-like rhythm. The compact floral geometry suits interior partitions, cabinet inserts, and screens wanting a classic Moroccan-inspired touch.
